messages.subject: INLA with Presence only data
parts:
Hi, 
I am trying to learn INLA and I am interested to use it  to model presence-only data, 
I found many tutorials online but I couldn't find anything with presence-only data, 
Can anyone point me to a good tutorial to implement INLA with presence points data? 
Thank you for your help
Angela

messages.author: 913ad7e9fa84081a
messages.subject: Re: INLA with Presence only data
parts:
Hi Angela,

I am currently working with presence-only data. Modeling this type of data can be challenging. The question here is not only about using INLA but also about how you model your data. Do you have any specific models in mind?

You have several options, but here are two that could be implemented in INLA (there could be more and better ones).

1. Presence/pseudo-absence Model with Bernoulli Distribution: instead of having only-presence data, consider generating pseudo-absences as suggested by Barbet-Massin et al., 2012. You can then model your presence-absence data using a Bernoulli distribution. In this book https://becarioprecario.bitbucket.io/spde-gitbook/index.html, you'll find code for adjusting a Non-Gaussian response variables; simply adapt the code to your specific case.

2. Point Process Model: another option is to consider a point process model, as discussed in the article by Renner et al., 2015. These models can be easily implemented in inlabru. For numerous examples, refer to this link https://inlabru-org.github.io/inlabru/articles/.

I hope this can help.

References
1. Barbet‐Massin, M., Jiguet, F., Albert, C. H., & Thuiller, W. (2012). Selecting pseudo‐absences for species distribution models: How, where and how many?. Methods in ecology and evolution, 3(2), 327-338.
2. Renner, I. W., Elith, J., Baddeley, A., Fithian, W., Hastie, T., Phillips, S. J., ... & Warton, D. I. (2015). Point process models for presence‐only analysis. Methods in Ecology and Evolution, 6(4), 366-379.
3. Martínez-Minaya, J., Cameletti, M., Conesa, D., & Pennino, M. G. (2018). Species distribution modeling: a statistical review with focus in spatio-temporal issues. Stochastic environmental research and risk assessment, 32, 3227-3244.

Bests,
Alba
